name: Shards of Her
source:
Hundreds of years ago, Michael, a demi-god with a heart full of love, experienced the profound loss of his beloved.

She disappeared, leaving no trace behind. Whether she perished or merely vanished remains a mystery. Despite his tireless search, she remained elusive. Eventually, he resigned himself to her absence, though he held her dear in his heart.

But Michael's world was turned upside down when Hemera, a once-beautiful goddess with unmatched beauty, cast him out of their sanctuary with a whisper. It was a place where light once thrived but grew dim when she vanished. Hemera's actions stirred something within him, reigniting his quest for answers about her fate...

As he embarks on a new quest for truth, he finds himself caught in the middle of an upcoming war against humans and the remaining gods. Stories tell of a sorceress with the power to manipulate time and bend the gods to her will. 

The answer to her disappearance might be somewhere in between...

[From [url=https://soulpersona.itch.io/shards-of-her]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
数百年前，迈克尔，一个内心充满爱的半神，经历了失去挚爱的深刻痛苦。

她消失了，没有留下任何痕迹。她是死了还是仅仅消失了仍然是个谜。尽管他孜孜不倦地寻找，她仍然难以捉摸。最终，他接受了她的缺席，尽管他心里很珍惜她。

但当曾经美丽无比的女神赫墨拉低声将迈克尔逐出庇护所时，他的世界发生了天翻地覆的变化。这是一个曾经光芒四射的地方，但当她消失后就变得黯淡了。赫墨拉的行为触动了他内心的某些东西，重新点燃了他对她命运答案的探寻……

当他开始对真理的新探索时，他发现自己陷入了一场即将到来的针对人类和剩余诸神的战争之中。故事讲述了一位女巫拥有操纵时间并使众神屈服于她的意志的能力。

她失踪的答案可能介于两者之间……

[来自[url=https://soulpersona.itch.io/shards-of-her]Itch.io[/url]]
